inspiration: Itanium C++ ABI 2.5 (vtable layout) and 2.9.5 (type_info); the class structures Ghidra's RecoverClassesFromRTTIScript and IDA's GCC RTTI reconstruction build
decisions: No new option: a third value on itaniumrtti (on|names|off).
Slot fields are code pointers without a signature: a guessed arity drops arguments at the call site.
A class type is emitted only with size evidence that covers every observed access through this: a too-small struct prints worse than none.
The receiver is an unlocked input hint, not a locked prototype: locking one parameter fixes the arity.
Flat class layouts; no base embedding in the first step.
